events.title: Hobbies & Mental Health: The Good, The Bad and Everything In Between
events.description:
Hobbies can bring joy, creativity, confidence and connection, but they can also come with stress, pressure, burnout and unrealistic expectations. This panel explores both the positive and negative impacts our passions can have on mental health, discussing how to find balance, recognise when we need a break and remember that hobbies should enrich our lives, not become another source of pressure.
